title: Q8_0 up-skip overhead localization plan after strict cold performance rejection

current_behavior: For every eligible expert call, allocates std::vector<uint8_t> h_src0 and copies the full MXFP4 tensor slice.
Allocates std::vector<uint8_t> h_q80 and copies selected Q8_0 activation rows.
Calls cudaMalloc for d_src0, d_q80, and d_out on every call.
Uses synchronous cudaMemcpy H2D for src0 and q80.
Launches one small kernel, then calls cudaDeviceSynchronize.
Copies d_out D2H, scatters into dst, writes optional report, then cudaFree for all three buffers.
code_observation.hypothesis: The current correct path is dominated by per-call allocation, H2D/D2H, launch/sync, and scatter overhead, so skipping CPU fallback is slower than leaving up on CPU.

instrumentation_plan.required_property: No behavior change unless GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_SKIP_PROFILE is enabled.
timers_ms: host src0 vector allocation plus memcpy
host q80 vector allocation plus row memcpy
instrumentation_plan.reporting: Emit one atexit summary line to stderr and, if PROFILE_OUT is set, write the same summary as key=value lines to that file. Do not write per-call traces in the default profiling mode.

localization_run_plan.initial_scope: France prompt strict cold with all-up q80 skip and profile enabled, unless build time or output volume makes this too costly; if needed, cap with GGML_MOE_STREAM_Q80_SKIP_MAX_CALLS for a bounded top1/short run.
localization_run_plan.pass_fail: This run is diagnostic only. It is not promotable as SOTA even if token rate changes, because instrumentation adds overhead.

hard_bound_decision_after_measurement.if_malloc_free_dominates: Replace per-call cudaMalloc/cudaFree with persistent slot buffers before any new benchmark; expected ceiling depends on measured alloc/free ms saved.
hard_bound_decision_after_measurement.if_h2d_src0_dominates: The current path reloads/copies full up expert payload per call and needs cache/reuse/batching; per-call GPU arithmetic alone is not viable.
hard_bound_decision_after_measurement.if_kernel_sync_or_d2h_dominates: A promotable design must batch/fuse experts or avoid the D2H/scatter boundary.
hard_bound_decision_after_measurement.if_down_fallback_dominates_after_up_fix: Return to down Q8_0 correctness root-cause before performance work.
hard_bound_decision_after_measurement.rejection_threshold: Reject any follow-up whose measured removable overhead cannot beat eval_tok_s 4.4 while keeping TTFT <= 33617.688744 ms.

commit_rule: Commit and push this plan before instrumentation. Commit and push instrumentation only after build and default-off top1/default path sanity pass. If any new compliant SOTA appears later, immediately record full repro and push source/artifacts.
